response.sql: WITH hand_counts AS (SELECT p.bats AS batting_hand, COUNT(*) AS appearance_count FROM appearances AS a JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = a.player_id GROUP BY p.bats) SELECT batting_hand, appearance_count, 1.0 * appearance_count / SUM(appearance_count) OVER () AS share_of_total, 1.0 * appearance_count / AVG(appearance_count) OVER () AS relative_to_average FROM hand_counts;

assumptions.assumption: A NULL batting hand, if present, is counted as its own group and included in both denominators.

alternatives.interpretation: Exclude appearances whose matched player has no recorded batting hand.
alternatives.sql: WITH hand_counts AS (SELECT p.bats AS batting_hand, COUNT(*) AS appearance_count FROM appearances AS a JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = a.player_id WHERE p.bats IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.bats) SELECT batting_hand, appearance_count, 1.0 * appearance_count / SUM(appearance_count) OVER () AS share_of_total, 1.0 * appearance_count / AVG(appearance_count) OVER () AS relative_to_average FROM hand_counts;
